column1: # Pinned item/action and Check-message grammars: key, exact regex, Java Pattern flags.

column2: ^Your Trident of the (seas|swamp)( \(e\))? has (?:((?:\d{1,3}(?:,\d{3})+|\d+)) charges|(one) charge|(no) charges)\.$

^(?:Your )?(Holy sanguinesti staff|Sanguinesti staff|warped sceptre|Tumeken's shadow|echo venator bow|venator bow|tonalztics of ralos)(?: only)? has (?:((?:\d{1,3}(?:,\d{3})+|\d+)) charges?|(one) charge|(no) charges?)(?: (?:remaining|left))?\.$

column1: # The sailors' amulet Check, both wordings (tictac7x Charges plugin regex; the owner's check line): "The amulet has 106 charges." / "Your amulet has 105 charges left.".

column2: ^(?:The|Your) amulet has (?:((?:\d{1,3}(?:,\d{3})+|\d+)) charges?|(one) charge|(no) charges?)(?: left)?\.$

column1: # A treasure trail's scrolls, boxes and caskets are claims on the casket's loot, held at zero.
# A player-owned house servant's name as his dialogue shows it (OSRS Wiki: Servant).
# Wood a house servant's sawmill trip takes (logs) or brings back (planks).
# A Barrows piece by its name without the 100/75/50/25/0 wear stage (OSRS Wiki: Barrows equipment).
# What an NPC takes in its dialogue for an item: coins, or a skilling currency (OSRS Wiki, 2026-08-19 update).
# Every Avernic defender variant (not the tradeable hilt): a death weighs it at its 600,000 repair cost.
# A chug's line per potion (OSRS Wiki; Dude Where's My Stuff, GIM Hub): the one-dose potion it drank.

column2: ^You have (?:[\d,]+ doses? of|finished all doses of) (.+?)(?: left)? in your barrel\.$

column1: # Bryophyta's staff Check and load lines (owner recording 2026-10-09).

column2: ^(?:The staff currently has|Your Bryophyta's staff now has) (?:([\d,]+) charges?|(one) charge|no charges)\.$

column1: # Uncharging Bryophyta's staff: the charges it destroys (owner recording 2026-10-09).

column2: ^You remove ([\d,]+) charges? from your staff, leaving it empty\.$
